description: Add a material to the price book, inside one of its categories. Requires a full-access Housecall Pro API key. Prices in DOLLARS - this server converts to Housecall Pro's integer cents for you. A material belongs to a category, so a category uuid is required - hcp_search_pricebook with kind='material_categories' has them, and hcp_create_pricebook_material_category makes a new one. Nothing is sent to any customer; this changes what your own price book offers.

cost_dollars.description: What it costs you, in dollars

material_category_uuid.description: The category to file it under, from hcp_search_pricebook kind='material_categories'

price_dollars.description: What you sell it for, in dollars

name: hcp_create_pricebook_material
